subject: Confession: I wrote this at 4AM
preview_text: The night I almost gave up on Thesis Generator — and why I didn't.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. But it's 4AM, I'm staring at my own blank page, and I realized something: I built this app because I know exactly what it feels like to be you right now. Deadline panic, imposter syndrome, the fear that you're one bad grade away from falling apart. I've been there.

Last week, I almost deleted the whole project. Thought it was just another tool nobody would use. Then I got a message from a student who said Thesis Generator saved her from dropping out. She was crying at 2AM, stuck on a history paper, and she used the humanize feature to bypass Turnitin. She got an A. That message kept me going.

You already have the app. But have you tried the one thing that changed everything for her? The humanize AI text feature. It rewrites your thesis so it sounds like you wrote it in 10 minutes, not 8 hours. No more worrying about AI detection. Just click "Humanize" and watch it transform.

Open your app now. Go to the thesis you're working on and hit the humanize button. See what happens. P.S. — I added a new export to PDF feature last night. One click, and your paper looks like you spent a week polishing it.
